prekindergarten; to amend chapter 91 of the laws of 2002 amending the

relation to the effectiveness thereof; to amend chapter 345 of the laws of

disabilities; to amend chapter 82 of the laws of 1995 amending the education

effectiveness thereof; providing for special apportionment for salary

residential school placements, in relation to the effectiveness thereof (Part

of monthly need for aged, blind and disabled persons living in the community
(Part L); to utilize reserves in the mortgage insurance fund for various
